verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the API uses an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible format. Users can point the OpenAI or Anthropic SDK, or compatible software, at DeepSeek just by changing configuration, and the Responses API format is natively supported. Tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and OpenCode can use DeepSeek as a backend with no code, and streaming and function-calling examples are given in OpenAI format. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that OpenAI-compatible tooling works against DeepSeek directly; step-by-step migration details (e.g., base URL and model-name mapping) are only implied, not shown in the evidence.
